title: Rockefeller files: correspondence routed through Hillary Clinton's office

tellings.quote: there was two documents in the Rockefeller files and I couldn't figure out what they were. One said all the stuff going from Rockefeller to the science adviser from science adviser to the Rockefeller is going through the mail the mailbox of Hillary Clinton.

plain: In the 1990s, messages going back and forth between the billionaire Laurance Rockefeller and the White House science adviser were passed through Hillary Clinton's mailbox, according to the researcher Grant Cameron. He tells Michels he found two documents in a set of papers he calls the Rockefeller files that he could not at first make sense of, and one of them said that everything going between Rockefeller and the science adviser was "going through the mail the mailbox of Hillary Clinton." Cameron offers it as a sign that the Clinton White House was looking into the UFO question with Rockefeller.
